prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your neighborhood, the exact problem, your budget, and whether you need emergency service or a warranty. That said, Houston has several well-reviewed, established companies you can consider:

- John Moore Services — large local company with 24/7 service, long history in Houston.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (also does HVAC) — national brand with local techs and emergency availability.
- Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning — national chain with Houston branches and maintenance plans.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin (local franchises) — often rated for punctuality and flat-rate pricing.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, AC & Electric — local multi-service company with good reviews for AC work.
- Aire Serv (local franchise) — another option with national backing and local technicians.

How to pick the best one for your situation
- Verify licensing and insurance (ask for the Texas license/registration number and proof of insurance).  
- Ask if techs are NATE-certified or manufacturer-certified for your brand.  
- Get 2–3 written estimates that break down parts, labor, diagnostic fee, and warranties.  
- Check recent Google/Yelp/BBB reviews and how the company responds to complaints.  
- Ask about emergency/after-hours fees, service guarantees, and workmanship warranties.  
- Prefer companies that will show up on time, provide a written estimate, and offer a clear warranty.

If you tell me your zip code/neighborhood and whether it’s an emergency (no cool air, strange noises, frequent cycling), I can pull up a short list of highly rated technicians near you and what customers say about them.
